text_blocks.snippet: The most common side effects of Opsumit (macitentan) include a stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, headache, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections.
snippet_highlighted_words: stuffy or runny nose, sore throat, headache, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections

list.snippet: Respiratory and Cold Symptoms: Stuffy or runny nose, sore throat (nasopharyngitis), and bronchitis.
General and Systemic: Headache and flu-like symptoms.
Blood: Anemia (low red blood cell count).
Severe Birth Defects: Opsumit causes major birth defects if taken during pregnancy and is strictly contraindicated for pregnant individuals.
Liver Damage: It can cause elevated liver enzymes and liver injury; doctors typically monitor liver function.
Fluid Retention: Swelling in the legs, ankles, or hands (peripheral edema) and potential pulmonary edema can occur, often within the first weeks of starting treatment.
Decreased Sperm Count: The medication may impair male fertility by reducing sperm counts.

text_blocks.snippet: For official prescribing details and safety guidelines, visit the [Official Opsumit Website](https://opsumit.com/) or consult your healthcare provider.
